common.homeDescription: Leo Monan is an independent product builder creating AI-native products across storytelling, desktop tools, automation, and interactive systems.
common.productTitle: AIStory — Stories that remember. | Leo Monan
common.productDescription: A personal story creation tool for illustrated, voiced episodes, recurring characters, and worlds you can keep building. Explore AIStory, currently in active development.
common.shareAlt: AIStory's illustrated story player and personal creation tools on three phones

home.lead: I design and build products from idea to production — across storytelling, desktop tools, automation, and interactive systems.
home.productsLead: A flagship story platform, a workspace for coding agents, and a shipped desktop understanding tool.
home.storyDescription: A story creation system where characters, voices, visuals, and continuity can persist across episodes and series — turning one-off generation into a world that can keep growing.
home.colookTagline: See what your coding agents are actually doing.
home.colookDescription: A desktop workspace for Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor Agent — bringing sessions, runtime state, and permission handling into one place.
home.translatorDescription: A low-interruption macOS tool that brings translation, explanation, terminology, and context next to the text or screenshot you’re already looking at.
home.systemsDescription: Some projects are products. Others are where I work on the reliability, runtime, and tooling ideas behind them.
home.aboutLead: I’m an independent product builder focused on AI-native software.
home.aboutDescription: I work across product thinking, interaction design, architecture, and implementation. I’m especially interested in products that remember, continue, and reliably get work done.

systems.name: AutoManus
systems.description: A local execution system that turns natural-language intent into verifiable, replayable desktop workflows.

systems.name: Order602
systems.description: Experiments in reusable runtime foundations for persistent interactive and spatial experiences.

systems.name: Commit Hooks
systems.description: Reusable Git quality gates for code hygiene, repository policy, and optional LLM-assisted review.

principles: The best AI products remember context and become more valuable with time.
Intelligence matters, but predictable execution and clear boundaries matter too.
I care about things people return to, not one-shot AI moments that disappear after first use.
